source_terms: Exact PR742 and PR792 base/head BSD-3-Clause notices are retained and checked against the original published issue-28 manifest. The bootstrap-ref BSD-3-Clause and Repo2RLEnv Apache-2.0 notices accompany the snapshot. No relicensing of third-party issue text or repository fixtures.
material: Original no-model bootstrap replay, smoke/native comparison, Harbor control and cleanup output archives. These contain generated execution records, dependency-install logs, source/test patch snippets, exported task files and attributed issue-derived instructions. Original source changes and test patches came from the reviewed issue-28 archive; the candidate applies only the general recorded-rebuild adaptation.
scientific_data: Repository regression-output text fixtures included in the original reviewed MACS patch lineage are adapted outputs, not newly acquired biological samples. No BAM, BAI, sequencing archive, image or Docker image is included. The publication scanner rejects non-text members except recursively inspected archive wrappers, unsafe members, credential signals and Git binary patches.
credential_boundary: These eight remote runs had no model or GitHub credentials and used isolated secret settings. Administrative submissions, account billing snapshots, local credentials, environment directories and unrelated files are excluded. A bounded exact-byte and nested-member scan is required before publication.
excluded: Full newly fetched issue-741 API snapshot
retention: Public research evidence only, retained while cited. This does not publish a task dataset, establish solver scores or guarantee exact-image reproduction.
correction: A null GitHub licenseInfo field did not invalidate the actual historical BSD notices already retained in issue 28. The previous issue-31 publication hold is superseded for this exact reviewed artifact set.
